facts.fact: The Data Protection Act 2022 is in force and the EDPA enforced it against MTN Eswatini in June 2024.
The Eswatini Communications Commission is designated as the data protection authority and is acting, having issued Enforcement Notice No. 3/2024.
The EDPA ruled against MTN Eswatini in Enforcement Notice No. 3/2024, a warning with eleven directed measures.
